title: A workout on the watch without the phone
description: The session you picked is on the watch in advance and comes back into the shared history after the run.

blocks.text: Someone buys a watch in order to leave the phone at home, and discovers the dependency only once they are outside.

quote.text: It is difficult to rate this app. I bought it due to the shameful lack of run apps that have a lap feature. In my excitement to purchase I neglected to see in the reviews - not in the description- that to use the Apple Watch you need to carry your phone. I bought the Apple Watch so I could run without

blocks.text: Test that a particular session is ready: opening it, the cues, finishing, and handing the recording over afterwards. Show the parts that are not available offline before the start.
A saved result has to survive a temporary loss of connection with the phone.
